summary: Seabridge Gold filed a Form 6-K reporting a news release about a regulatory/legal development affecting its KSM Project. The Gitxsan Huwilp Government withdrew its 2013 letter of support and called for meaningful consultation with the Tsetsaut Skii km La Hax, following a BC Supreme Court order in June 2026 requiring further consultation on whether the project was substantially started. The filing is a routine update on ongoing permitting and consultation processes, with no corporate action such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The registrant is the project owner, not a counterparty to a special-situation transaction.
